-- Universal DZ compositor: preserve mission lines while owning deployment visibility.
local function loboUniversalWrite(target,lines)
 if target.getGUID()=="f20060" then
  local owner=getObjectFromGUID("e25860")
  if owner and not owner.isDestroyed() then
   local ok,handled=pcall(function()return owner.call('loboUniversalSetBase',{guid=target.getGUID(),lines=lines})end)
   if ok and handled then return end
  end
 end
 target.setVectorLines(lines)
end
-- BEGIN LOBO CONTRAST DEPLOYMENT LINES V2
-- Every colored centerline remains at its exact measured X/Z coordinates.
local function loboContrastDraw(target,source)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() then return end
 local strokes={}
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {}) do
  if line.points and #line.points>1 then
   local width=tonumber(line.thickness) or .015
   local border,core={},{}
   for k,v in pairs(line) do border[k]=v;core[k]=v end
   border.color={.006,.009,.014}
   border.thickness=width+.01
   core.thickness=width
   local c=line.color or {1,1,1}
   local r,g,b=c.r or c[1] or 1,c.g or c[2] or 1,c.b or c[3] or 1
   local maximum=math.max(r,g,b,.001)
   r,g,b=r/maximum,g/maximum,b/maximum
   if b>r*1.5 and b>g then g=math.max(g,.82);r=math.min(r,.18)
   elseif r>b*1.5 and r>=g then
    if g>.7 then g=math.max(g,.95);b=math.min(b,.12)
    else g=math.max(g,.55);b=math.min(b,.16) end
   end
   core.color={r,g,b}
   core.points={}
   for _,p in ipairs(line.points) do
    local world=target.positionToWorld(Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3]))
    world.y=world.y+.004
    local q=target.positionToLocal(world)
    core.points[#core.points+1]={q.x,q.y,q.z}
   end
   strokes[#strokes+1]=border
   strokes[#strokes+1]=core
  end
 end
 loboUniversalWrite(target,strokes)
end
-- END LOBO CONTRAST DEPLOYMENT LINES V2

local function loboLifeAlive()
 if loboLifeDead or self.isDestroyed() then return false end
 if loboLifeAnchor then
  local anchor=getObjectFromGUID(loboLifeAnchor)
  if loboLifeWasPlaced and (not anchor or anchor.isDestroyed()) then return false end
  local p=self.getPosition()
  if anchor and math.abs(p.x)<=44 and math.abs(p.z)<=26 and math.abs(p.y)<=26 then loboLifeWasPlaced=true end
 end
 return true
end
local function loboLifeGetBroker()
 if loboLifeBroker and not loboLifeBroker.isDestroyed() then return loboLifeBroker end
 local guid=Global.getVar('LoboMapUIBrokerV4')
 local broker=guid and getObjectFromGUID(guid) or nil
 if not broker then
  for _,candidate in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag('LoboMapUIBrokerV4') or {}) do broker=candidate;break end
 end
 if not broker then
  broker=spawnObjectData({data=JSON.decode(loboLifeBrokerData)})
  if broker then Global.setVar('LoboMapUIBrokerV4',broker.getGUID()) end
 end
 loboLifeBroker=broker;return broker
end
local function loboLifeCall(name,p)
 local broker=loboLifeBroker
 if not broker or broker.isDestroyed() or not loboLifeToken then return nil end
 p=p or {};p.owner=loboLifeOwner;p.token=loboLifeToken
 return broker.call(name,p)
end

local UI=setmetatable({

 setAttribute=function(id,key,value) if loboLifeAlive() then loboLifeCall('loboUISetAttribute',{id=id,attribute=key,value=value}) end end,
 getCustomAssets=function() return loboNativeUI.getCustomAssets() end
},{__index=function(_,key) return loboNativeUI[key] end})
local function loboLifeStop(id)
 if id and loboLifeWaits[id] then loboNativeWait.stop(id);loboLifeWaits[id]=nil end
end
local function loboLifeGuard(fn)
 return function(...) if loboLifeAlive() then return fn(...) end end
end
local Wait={}
function Wait.stop(id) loboLifeStop(id) end
function Wait.time(fn,delay,repetitions)
 local id
 id=loboNativeWait.time(function()
  if not loboLifeAlive() then loboLifeStop(id);return end
  if not repetitions or repetitions==1 then loboLifeWaits[id]=nil end
  return fn()
 end,delay,repetitions)
 loboLifeWaits[id]=true;return id
end
function Wait.frames(fn,frames)
 local id
 id=loboNativeWait.frames(function() loboLifeWaits[id]=nil;return loboLifeGuard(fn)() end,frames)
 loboLifeWaits[id]=true;return id
end
function Wait.condition(fn,condition,timeout,onTimeout)
 local id
 id=loboNativeWait.condition(function() loboLifeWaits[id]=nil;return loboLifeGuard(fn)() end,
  function() return not loboLifeAlive() or condition() end,timeout,
  function() loboLifeWaits[id]=nil;if onTimeout then return loboLifeGuard(onTimeout)() end end)
 loboLifeWaits[id]=true;return id
end

function onLoad() self.setLock(true) end
function onDestroy()
 local key="clearingAsterionCampus"
 if Global.getVar(key) then return end
 Global.setVar(key,true)
 local doomed={}
 for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
  if o~=self and o.hasTag("LoboMap:ca7100") then table.insert(doomed,o) end
 end
 for _,o in ipairs(doomed) do o.destruct() end
 Global.setVar(key,false)
end



-- BEGIN LOBO TOP 40 MAP 1 CONTROLS

local loboTop40Deployment = false
local loboTop40Readers = {}
local loboTop40Pages = {}

local function loboTop40Mat()
    return self
end

local function loboTop40DrawDeployment()
    local mat = loboTop40Mat()
    if not mat then return end
    local lines = {}
    local function line(points, color, thickness)
        local localPoints = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(points) do
            table.insert(localPoints, mat.positionToLocal(Vector(p[1], 1.13, p[2])))
        end
        table.insert(lines, {points=localPoints, color=color, thickness=thickness or 0.015})
    end
    if loboTop40Deployment then
        local blue, orange, yellow = {0.2,0.65,1}, {1,0.4,0.16}, {1,0.82,0.15}
        line({{-12,-24},{-12,24}}, blue)
        line({{12,-24},{12,24}}, orange)
        -- Dashed borders: exclusion zone is X=-4 to +4, across the table.
        for _, x in ipairs({-4,4}) do
            for z=-24,22,2 do line({{x,z},{x,z+1}}, yellow, 0.01) end
        end
    end
    loboContrastDraw(mat, lines)
    UI.setAttribute('loboTop40DeploymentButton','text',
        loboTop40Deployment and 'Deployment: ON' or 'Deployment: OFF')
end

function loboTop40ToggleDeployment(player, value, id)
    loboTop40Deployment = not loboTop40Deployment
    loboTop40DrawDeployment()
end

local function loboTop40UpdateReaders()
    local colors = {}
    local pages = {{},{},{},{},{},{}}
    for color, visible in pairs(loboTop40Readers) do
        if visible then
            table.insert(colors,color)
            table.insert(pages[loboTop40Pages[color] or 1],color)
        end
    end
    table.sort(colors)
    UI.setAttribute('loboTop40MissionPanel','visibility',table.concat(colors,'|'))
    UI.setAttribute('loboTop40MissionPanel','active',#colors>0 and 'true' or 'false')
    for page, readers in ipairs(pages) do
        table.sort(readers)
        UI.setAttribute('loboTop40Page'..page,'visibility',table.concat(readers,'|'))
        UI.setAttribute('loboTop40Page'..page,'active',#readers>0 and 'true' or 'false')
    end
end

function loboTop40SelectPage(player, value, id)
    if not player or not player.color then return end
    local page=tonumber(string.match(id or '', '^loboTop40Tab([1-6])$'))
    if not page then return end
    loboTop40Pages[player.color]=page
    loboTop40Readers[player.color]=true
    loboTop40UpdateReaders()
end

function loboTop40ToggleMission(player, value, id)
    if not player or not player.color then return end
    loboTop40Readers[player.color] = not loboTop40Readers[player.color]
    loboTop40UpdateReaders()
end

function loboTop40CloseMission(player, value, id)
    if not player or not player.color then return end
    loboTop40Readers[player.color] = nil
    loboTop40UpdateReaders()
end

local function loboTop40RemoveUI()
    local roots = UI.getXmlTable() or {}
    for i=#roots,1,-1 do
        local a=roots[i].attributes or {}
        if a.id=='loboTop40MapControls' then table.remove(roots,i) end
    end
    UI.setXmlTable(roots)
end
local function loboTop40InstallUI()
    loboTop40RemoveUI()
    local roots=UI.getXmlTable() or {}
    local template=string.gsub(loboTop40UITemplate,'__SELF__',self.getGUID())
    table.insert(roots,{tag='Panel',attributes={id='loboTop40MapControls',
        width='100%',height='100%',raycastTarget='false'},children=JSON.decode(template)})
    UI.setXmlTable(roots)
    Wait.frames(function()
        if self.isDestroyed() then return end
        loboTop40Readers={}
        loboTop40UpdateReaders()
        loboTop40DrawDeployment()
    end,3)
end
local loboTop40PreviousLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
    if loboTop40PreviousLoad then loboTop40PreviousLoad(saved) end
    if saved and saved~='' then
        local ok,data=pcall(JSON.decode,saved)
        if ok and type(data)=='table' then loboTop40Deployment=data.deployment==true end
    end
    -- The standard SET_ loader first extracts objects off-table, then aligns them.
    Wait.condition(loboTop40InstallUI,function()
        if self.isDestroyed() then return false end
        local p=self.getPosition()
        return math.abs(p.x)<26 and math.abs(p.z)<26 and p.y<10
    end,120)
end
function onSave()
    return JSON.encode({deployment=loboTop40Deployment})
end
local loboTop40PreviousDestroy=onDestroy
function onDestroy()
    loboTop40RemoveUI()
    if loboTop40PreviousDestroy then loboTop40PreviousDestroy() end
end

-- BEGIN LOBO BASE-TO-TOP HEIGHT V1
-- Rendered model bounds already include the object's current scale.
-- Project the normalized renderer bounds onto vertical; world elevation is irrelevant.
local loboHeightTimer=nil
local loboHeightPrefix='Height (base to top): '
local function loboHeightBody(description)
 local s=description or ''
 if string.sub(s,1,#loboHeightPrefix)==loboHeightPrefix then
  local e=string.find(s,'\n',1,true)
  return e and string.sub(s,e+1) or ''
 end
 return s
end
local function loboHeightRefresh()
 if self.isDestroyed() or self.loading_custom then return false end
 local ok,bounds=pcall(function() return self.getVisualBoundsNormalized() end)
 if not ok or not bounds or not bounds.size then return false end
 local size=bounds.size
 if not size.x or not size.y or not size.z then return false end
 local right,up,forward=self.getTransformRight(),self.getTransformUp(),self.getTransformForward()
 local height=math.abs(right.y)*size.x+math.abs(up.y)*size.y+math.abs(forward.y)*size.z
 if height~=height or height<=0.001 or height==math.huge then return false end
 local description=loboHeightPrefix..string.format('%.2f in',height)
 local body=loboHeightBody(self.getDescription())
 if body~='' then description=description..'\n'..body end
 if self.getDescription()~=description then self.setDescription(description) end
 self.tooltip=true
 return true
end
local function loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightTimer then Wait.stop(loboHeightTimer);loboHeightTimer=nil end
end
local function loboHeightBegin()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightRefresh() then return end
 local tries=0
 loboHeightTimer=Wait.time(function()
  tries=tries+1
  if self.isDestroyed() or loboHeightRefresh() or tries>=90 then loboHeightStop() end
 end,1,90)
end
local loboHeightPreviousLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 if loboHeightPreviousLoad then loboHeightPreviousLoad(saved) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousState=onStateChange
function onStateChange(oldGuid)
 if loboHeightPreviousState then loboHeightPreviousState(oldGuid) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousHover=onHover
function onHover(color)
 if loboHeightPreviousHover then loboHeightPreviousHover(color) end
 loboHeightRefresh()
end
local loboHeightPreviousDestroy=onDestroy
function onDestroy()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightPreviousDestroy then loboHeightPreviousDestroy() end
end
-- END LOBO BASE-TO-TOP HEIGHT V1

local loboCampusQuarterScaleY=0.68421052631578949
local loboCampusQuarterBases={["f20061"]=0,["f20062"]=0}
local function loboCampusQuarterApply()
 local scale=self.getScale()
 if math.abs(scale.y-loboCampusQuarterScaleY)>0.0000000001 then
  self.setScale({scale.x,loboCampusQuarterScaleY,scale.z})
 end
end
local loboCampusQuarterPreviousLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 loboCampusQuarterApply()
 if loboCampusQuarterPreviousLoad then loboCampusQuarterPreviousLoad(saved) end
end
local loboCampusQuarterPreviousState=onStateChange
function onStateChange(oldGuid)
 loboCampusQuarterApply()
 local before=loboCampusQuarterBases[oldGuid]
 local after=loboCampusQuarterBases[self.getGUID()]
 if before and after and math.abs(before-after)>0.00000001 then
  local p=self.getPosition()
  self.setPosition({p.x,p.y+before-after,p.z})
 end
 if loboCampusQuarterPreviousState then loboCampusQuarterPreviousState(oldGuid) end
end
-- END LOBO CAMPUS QUARTER-INCH HEIGHT V1
